title: Pleasantly surprised
text: This is my 2nd order from American Plant Exchange and I have 2 more healthy looking plants. A parlor palm and prayer plant that only suffered 1 broken leaf between them. The UPS man delivered the package upright as the box states, which I believe makes a difference. Plants have moist soil, no brown spots, and instructions with fertilizer. I’m looking forward to my next shipment and watching these plants grow.
label: positive
